TEMPLE VISIT GUIDE

Know which temples your trip covers.

Use the trip lists to compare visits around Tirupati and Tirumala with longer routes through South India.

How many temples are covered?

Our Complete 7-Temple Trip includes seven temples. Other trips cover different temple routes, shown on each trip page or in its day-by-day plan. Choose the trip you prefer, then confirm its stops with the owner on WhatsApp before agreeing to the booking.

Temple visits around Tirupati and Tirumala

  • Sri Venkateswara Temple — Tirumala
  • Varahaswamy Temple — Tirumala
  • Sri Padmavathi Ammavari Temple — Tiruchanur
  • Govindaraja Swamy Temple — Tirupati
  • Kapila Theertham — Tirupati
  • ISKCON Temple — Tirupati

These stops appear in different family and day-wise trips. They are not automatically included in every trip. Open the selected trip page to check its exact stops.

The complete seven-temple route

  • Sri Venkateswara Temple — Tirumala
  • Sri Padmavathi Ammavari Temple — Tiruchanur
  • Sri Kalahasteeswara Temple — Srikalahasti
  • Sri Varasiddhi Vinayaka Temple — Kanipakam
  • Sri Lakshmi Narayani Golden Temple — Vellore
  • Sri Kamakshi Amman Temple — Kanchipuram
  • Sri Arunachaleswarar Temple — Tiruvannamalai

This is a wider route that also includes Srikalahasti, Kanipakam, Vellore, Kanchipuram and Tiruvannamalai. It is not a list of seven temples located within Tirupati city.

Before you travel

Confirm your dates, covered stops, visit order, transport and accommodation with the owner. Temple timings and access can affect the final plan.

We only guide you on how to book Tirumala darshan tickets. We do not book tickets for you. Darshan is subject to official availability.

Check current darshan information with Tirumala Tirupati Devasthanams (TTD). Use TTD’s official online services to check ticket availability and book directly. We provide guidance only.

Which temples are in Tirumala and Tirupati?

Sri Venkateswara Temple
Tirumala, in the hills above Tirupati. Dedicated to Lord Venkateswara.
Sri Padmavathi Ammavari Temple
Tiruchanur, near Tirupati. Dedicated to Goddess Padmavathi.
Sri Govindaraja Swamy Temple
In Tirupati city. Dedicated to Lord Govindaraja Swamy.
Kapila Theertham
At the foot of the Tirumala hills in Tirupati. The temple is dedicated to Lord Shiva.

Tirumala and Tirupati city are different stops. The wider seven-temple trip also travels beyond this local area; choose the route by its listed stops, not only its name.

Temple location reference: Tirupati District religious tourism guide. Check current darshan information with TTD; travel time and entry arrangements must be confirmed for your date.
